name: luis-dev-portfolio
description: Portafolio: backend (API REST) y frontend (SPA) independientes

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
